ai.title: Reduce anonymous tier credits to 250
ai.summary: Anonymous tier credit limit reduced from 500 to 250 in common/src/constants.ts. Updates CREDITS_USAGE_LIMITS for ANON. Affects quota enforcement logic.

eli5.text: Visitors who aren't signed in can no longer use as many free credits as before. The amount of credits they get has been cut from 500 down to 250. If you use the service without logging in, you'll reach your limit faster than you did previously. This change is already live today and affects everyone in the anonymous tier.
